Summary: 7 requirements reviewed: 7 with issues, 0 without. 7 issues found (5 Medium, 2 Low). Types: Vague_Language (2), Incomplete_Requirement (3), Ambiguous_Statement (2).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for all online banking sessions.
REQ-002: The system shall complete 99% of fund transfers within 2 seconds under 1,000 concurrent users.
REQ-003: The system shall prevent duplicate debits and credits when a transfer request is retried by the user.
REQ-004: Every successful fund transfer shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a recovery time objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
REQ-006: All Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification.
REQ-007: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-001: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for all online banking sessions.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The term 'online banking sessions' has no objective definition in the document, so the scope is unclear.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define what constitutes an online banking session for the purpose of MFA enforcement.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-002: The system shall complete 99% of fund transfers within 2 seconds under 1,000 concurrent users.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify the measurement conditions for 'within 2 seconds', such as network latency or system load.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the exact conditions under which the 2-second transfer completion time is measured.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-003: The system shall prevent duplicate debits and credits when a transfer request is retried by the user.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: It is unclear whether 'retried by the user' refers to the user retrying the transfer request or the system retrying the request.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Clarify whether the user or the system initiates the retry of the transfer request.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-004: Every successful fund transfer shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify what constitutes a 'successful fund transfer' or how to verify it.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the conditions for a successful fund transfer and the verification method.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a recovery time objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The terms 'regional outage' and 'recovery' are not defined, so the scope and behavior are unclear.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define what constitutes a regional outage and the specific recovery process required.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-006: All Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify the type of Transaction audit records or the protection mechanism.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the specific types of Transaction audit records and the encryption or access controls for protection.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-007: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The term 'application components' has no objective definition in the document, so the scope is unclear.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define which application components are considered for encryption in transit.
